name: @ingress-shards/ingress-events-core
description: Core logic for Ingress applications which interact with events
author: Lewis Keen

scripts.clean: node -e "['dist', 'gen'].forEach(d => require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build: tsdown && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/conf/recent', { recursive: true }); require('fs').copyFileSync('conf/event_blueprints.json', 'dist/conf/event_blueprints.json'); require('fs').copyFileSync('conf/season_manifest.json', 'dist/conf/season_manifest.json'); if (require('fs').existsSync('gen/conf/season_geocode.json')) require('fs').copyFileSync('gen/conf/season_geocode.json', 'dist/conf/season_geocode.json'); if (require('fs').existsSync('gen/conf/recent/season_manifest.json')) require('fs').copyFileSync('gen/conf/recent/season_manifest.json', 'dist/conf/recent/season_manifest.json'); if (require('fs').existsSync('gen/conf/recent/season_geocode.json')) require('fs').copyFileSync('gen/conf/recent/season_geocode.json', 'dist/conf/recent/season_geocode.json')"
scripts.validate: yarn clean && yarn generate && tsc --noEmit && yarn lint && yarn build && vitest run --coverage
scripts.validate:docker: docker build -f Dockerfile.validate -t ingress-events-core-validate . && docker run --rm ingress-events-core-validate
